summary.text: Use the e-Service with your application reference number and the e-mail address you gave when you applied.

steps.name: Open the e-Service
steps.text: Go to the e-Service to enquire about your extract or search application status.

items: Open the e-Service to check your application status.

steps.text: Enter your application reference number and the e-mail address you provided during your application to access the status function.
